verdict.rationale: Location and hardware provisioning is a fair axis for a POS product, but the evidence pack never documents an API for creating locations or registering card readers. The only API mention is POS UI extensions querying the GraphQL Admin API, which is an adjacent developer building block and earns no credit here. Multi-location support and the POS Hub hardware are UI and product features, not programmatic provisioning.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new location end-to-end via API — creating the location and registering its readers
